verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe agents claiming tasks, approval gates, and PR review comments (e.g. @foreloop retest/link), but there is no evidence of a chat thread interface where a developer can @-tag an agent to discuss and delegate a bug/task interactively. missing for 10: evidence of a chat/thread UI, an @-mention-to-delegate mechanism, and conversational back-and-forth with an agent.
